Kenneth Tropin increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 1227.49% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Graham Capital Management Lp bought 70,900 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Kenneth Tropin held 76,676 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $12.87 million, up from 5,776 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Graham Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $935.06 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.80% or $3.37 during the last trading session, reaching $190.24. About 21.25M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
